caption: What the Amateur Extra upgrade opens: the Extra-only slices of four HF bands — 3.500–3.525 and 3.600–3.800 MHz on 80/75 m, 7.000–7.025 and 7.125–7.175 MHz on 40 m, 14.000–14.025 and 14.150–14.225 MHz on 20 m (the DX-heavy bottom of the phone band), and 21.000–21.025 and 21.200–21.275 MHz on 15 m — lighting up on top of everything General already had. Extra adds spectrum and takes nothing away: all of 160, 60, 30, 17, 12, and 10 m and every VHF/UHF band stay exactly as they were. Edges per §97.301(b) vs §97.301(d), ITU Region 2.
spoken: four horizontal band bars — 80/75, 40, 20, and 15 meters — with the Extra-only slices filled in at the bottom of each band and their exact frequency edges labeled, above a note that everything General had remains
